title: Good but certain features / pop ups need adjustments
body:
The application is extremely useful and is the best one I have found to help me organize my day and workday 

The AI features and coaching features are extremely useful and save me so much time than having to do certain tasks manually

However, even though I am a premium user, I keep getting asked to sign up again to receive an extra 3 months for free, even though I keep clicking the X every time it shows up, it keeps coming up every 3-4 hours when I use the app which can get annoying
